sections.name: Explore
sections.today: Browse the two studies, read every public release with its citation and SHA-256, and open the generated evidence views. No sign-in.
sections.missing: Search, collections and any study that is not the author's.

sections.name: Design
sections.today: Download the factorial protocol template. The registry validates a protocol's design, models and budget before it will store it, and records the parent of an amended study.
sections.missing: A way for anyone but the owner to fork a design. Templates for other kinds of study.

sections.name: Laboratory
sections.today: The owner can run a bounded experiment: at most 96 conversations and 100,000 output tokens per study. Failures and interruptions are recorded, never retried silently.
sections.missing: Workspaces, budgets and permissions for other researchers. Importing observations collected elsewhere.

sections.name: Analyze
sections.today: Verify a released Identity Dissolution bundle and reproduce its analysis package from the published script. Failed runs stay missing; they are not counted as zero.
sections.missing: Analysis for annotation data. Any declared link between a kind of evidence and the methods that are valid for it.

sections.name: Collaborate
sections.today: The owner can create rater accounts and assign runs for annotation. A rater sees only what is assigned.
sections.missing: Invitations, reviewer and contributor roles, and any record of who a contributor is beyond a name.

sections.name: Publish
sections.today: The owner can release a study's evidence as a hashed bundle with a citation. Each release is its own reviewed action.
sections.missing: A review record, a recorded publication decision, corrections, and DOI deposition. Persona material has no release path.

sections.name: Learn
sections.today: Read the evidence standards, the ethics commitments, a public audit of the author's own argument, and the research-object contract.
sections.missing: Guided paths for someone designing a first study. Teaching material on statistics and uncertainty.
